snippet.title: Backyard Baseball Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description: Watch the cinematic trailer for the brand-new Backyard Baseball video game! With enhanced gameplay, new modes (like online multiplayer!), and all the humor and charm of the original, get ready to play like a kid on July 9th!
